findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_indicators" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the 103-indicator registry by keyword. Returns ranked matches (up to `limit`, default 10, max 50) with slug, branded name, underlying name, category, and…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_county_scorecard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
